summary: Open-Meteo's current conditions, hourly strip and 10-day forecast for where you are, or for any place you type.
notes: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). Type meteo, or meteo and a place. With location allowed, Volant sends Open-Meteo your position rounded to about ten kilometers; meteo and a place name looks the place up instead and needs no location.
